subject: Azure Marketplace listing: account handoff, tech validation plan and docs
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Matt Chen <matt.chen@microsoft.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Azure Marketplace listing: account handoff, tech validation plan and docs

Matt — following up from last week's sync. We're ready to move the listing into Partner Center but want to align on the remaining technical validation steps and account handoff items so the publish window is predictable. Quick summary of what we attached and what we need from you: 

- Attached: redwood_manifest_v1.json (SKU mappings + SaaS plan), publisher_identity_proof.pdf (company articles + notarized letter), sso_test_creds.txt (temporary test tenant creds).
- Ask 1: Confirm the tenant verification procedure you want us to follow (Partner Center verification vs. MSAM identity proofing).
- Ask 2: Confirm required manifest fields for co-sell opt-in (we plan to opt-in for co-sell but need the exact SKU/plan metadata).
- Ask 3: Can you enable a test publish slot or sandbox listing so we can validate the UI/links before production publish?

Proposed timeline: technical validation call this Wednesday 08/19 at 10:00 PT, target production publish the following week assuming no blockers.

Please route any DocuSign or publisher forms to me and cc Soojin on technical items.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Marketplace Programs | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: redwood_manifest_v1.json (application/json), publisher_identity_proof.pdf (application/pdf), sso_test_creds.txt (text/plain)
From: Matt Chen <matt.chen@microsoft.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Azure Marketplace Onboarding <marketplace-onboarding@microsoft.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace listing: account handoff, tech validation plan and docs

Hi Naomi — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. We're excited to get Redwood across the finish line. Quick responses inline: 

- Tenant verification: for your case (new publisher with reserved SaaS listing) we need both Partner Center verification (publisher ID mapping) and the notarized identity proof. Your publisher_identity_proof.pdf looks fine at a glance.
- Manifest fields for co-sell: we'll need SKU-level pricing type, ARM template references if applicable, and the coSellEligible boolean. I'll attach the partnercenter_manifest_template.docx in a follow-up email.
- Sandbox publish slot: we can provision a validation sandbox tenant for you. I need the publisher ID and a contact who can accept the invite (email).

Scheduling: Wednesday 08/19 at 10:00 PT works for our validation engineer. I can send a calendar invite.

Next steps for you: send the Partner Center publisher ID and confirm the email for the sandbox invite. I'll also send a DocuSign for the co-sell opt-in form (expect within 24 hours).

Best,
Matt Chen
Azure Marketplace Technical Onboarding
matt.chen@microsoft.com

Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace listing: account handoff, tech validation plan and docs

Hi Matt — thanks, sending the publisher ID and sandbox contact now.

Publisher ID: REDW-32714
Sandbox contact: soojin.lee@redwood.ai (Soojin will accept the invite and run the validation tests).

A couple of technical clarifications beforehand so the call is focused: 
- We have two SKU types: SaaS (consumption-based per-token API) and Reserved (monthly dedicated capacity). The manifest currently maps them as "redwood-saas" and "redwood-dedicated". On co-sell metadata we plan to set coSellEligible=true only on the Reserved SKU. Confirm that's acceptable.
- We will host the ARM deployment artifacts in the Partner Center but would like the marketplace listing to surface links to our docs + a small quickstart ARM template. If the validation sandbox requires the artifacts to be live, let us know and we'll publish to a temp blob.
- SSO: Our enterprise sales team will need to show a SAML sample in the sandbox (we included sso_test_creds.txt). If you need a federated test tenant instead please advise.

Attached: redwood_manifest_v1.json (updated with SKU descriptions) — let us know if we should pivot to the partnercenter template you mentioned.

See you on the call tomorrow.

--
Naomi

Thanks Naomi / Matt — confirmed for 08/19 10:00 PT (I've accepted the calendar invite). For the validation call I'll bring our infra engineer and a product lead; agenda below so we can keep it to 30–40 minutes:

Agenda (30–40m):
1) Quick intro + publish roles (5m)
2) Manifest walkthrough (redwood_manifest_v1.json) — SKU mappings, co-sell flag, ARM artifact references (10m)
3) Sandbox access & SSO validation approach (SAML test flow, credential handoff) (10m)
4) Publish timeline, checklist items, and final DocuSign/opt-in (5–10m)

Pre-call checklist (we will have these ready):
- Publisher ID: REDW-32714 (provided)
- Updated manifest attached (we'll copy any required fields into your template if needed)
- SSO test creds included in sso_test_creds.txt — if you prefer a federated tenant we can provision one but need the MSAM contact to enable it
- Publisher identity docs attached (publisher_identity_proof.pdf)

Attachments referenced in drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-azure-listing-assets — includes the manifest, screenshots of portal settings, and a short runbook for QA steps.

If there are any additional pre-reqs (e.g., ARM template signing or specific content checks) let us know before the call and we'll prepare. Looking forward to the validation.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Marketplace Programs | Redwood Inference
